strategies.focus: Lean 4 projects outside the start set.
strategies.how: Read Reservoir (https://reservoir.lean-lang.org), GitHub topic pages (https://github.com/topics/lean4, https://github.com/topics/mathlib), the Lean community's website (https://leanprover-community.github.io) for project lists and blueprints, and grep.app (https://grep.app/search?q=%5Cuses%7B&filter[lang][0]=TeX) for blueprint repositories.

strategies.focus: Rocq/Coq developments outside the start set.
strategies.how: Read the Rocq package index (https://rocq-prover.org/packages), the coq-community and math-comp organisations on GitHub (https://github.com/coq-community, https://github.com/math-comp), and GitHub topic pages (https://github.com/topics/coq, https://github.com/topics/rocq).

strategies.focus: Isabelle developments outside the AFP (the AFP is registered as one source, afp).
strategies.how: Read GitHub topic pages (https://github.com/topics/isabelle, https://github.com/topics/isabelle-hol), the isabelle-prover organisation, and artefact links on the Isabelle website (https://isabelle.in.tum.de) and in recent ITP and CPP proceedings pages.

strategies.focus: LLM proving systems and agent skills whose repositories hold decomposition prompts or proof outputs (Lean, Rocq or Isabelle).
strategies.how: Read GitHub topic pages (https://github.com/topics/theorem-proving, https://github.com/topics/autoformalization), the READMEs of benchmark repositories (miniF2F, PutnamBench, ProofNet) for linked prover systems and released solutions, and Hugging Face model cards that link code.

strategies.focus: Snowballing from the registered Lean sources.
strategies.how: For each registered Lean source (library/sources/*/source.json with Lean files), read its README for linked or related projects and its lake-manifest.json or lakefile for project dependencies (skip general libraries: mathlib, batteries, aesop, plausible, proofwidgets, LeanSearchClient, importGraph, Qq), and follow papers it cites to their code.

strategies.focus: Snowballing from the registered Rocq sources.
strategies.how: For each registered Rocq source, read its README, opam file and _CoqProject for dependencies and related developments (skip general libraries such as stdpp, coq-ext-lib, equations), and follow cited developments to their code.

strategies.focus: Snowballing from the registered Isabelle sources (l4v, autocorrode, munkres-isabelle, isabelle-pide-ai, isabelle-dist, afp).
strategies.how: Read their READMEs and ROOT files for sessions and projects outside the AFP that they depend on or cite, and the papers they cite for linked artefacts.
